title: Decorator Pattern
overview: Attach additional responsibilities to an object dynamically by wrapping it in decorator objects.
useCases: You want to add additional functionality to a class without changing it
The class cannot or should not be modified
You need to combine multiple behaviours independently at runtime (e.g. logging + caching + auth on a service)
exampleUses: Wrapping an InputStream with BufferedInputStream, then GZIPInputStream to layer buffering and compression
Adding toll and express-lane surcharges on top of a base taxi fare without subclassing the Taxi class
Layering middleware on an HTTP handler — rate limiting, authentication, and request logging each as separate decorators
